media_work.title: 60 Minutes
media_work.focus_or_theme: Coerced false confessions, police interrogation techniques, impact on families.
media_work.summaryNotes: Highlighted a case where intense interrogation led a grieving father to falsely confess.

media_item.focus_or_theme: Coerced false confessions, police interrogation techniques, impact on families.
media_item.summary_notes: The segment focuses on the case of Kevin Fox, who was wrongly accused of murdering his daughter. It highlights the coercive interrogation techniques used by police and the impact on Fox and his family.
key_quotes_raw: Likely includes interviews with Kevin and Melissa Fox discussing the interrogation and ordeal.
systemic_issues_raw: Coercive interrogation tactics used on vulnerable individuals (like a grieving parent)
The trauma inflicted by false accusations and wrongful incarceration.
policy_recommendations_raw: Implied need for mandatory recording of interrogations
Better training for detectives on avoiding coercion
Less reliance on confessions obtained under duress.

external_links_raw.description: FindLaw case summary of civil suit FOX v. HAYES (Provides detailed background).

featured_individuals.crime_convicted_of_raw: Accused of murdering his daughter, Riley Fox.
featured_individuals.narrative_summary: Kevin Fox was wrongly accused of murdering his daughter. He was subjected to a lengthy and coercive interrogation, leading to a false confession. Charges were dropped after DNA evidence excluded him as the perpetrator, and he later won a civil rights lawsuit.
contributing_factors_raw: Failed polygraph used to increase pressure.
